title.en: seattle christmas market at seattle center opens today.
title.de: weihnachtsmarkt im seattle center beginnt heute.
title.tr: seattle center'da noel pazarı bugün açılıyor.

line.en: the market runs through the holidays; timed entry tickets are booked ahead and hours vary by day, so check the site before you go.
line.de: der markt läuft bis weihnachten; zeitfenster-tickets vorab buchen, die öffnungszeiten wechseln je nach tag, also vorher auf der seite prüfen.
line.tr: pazar tatil boyunca açık; zaman dilimli biletleri önceden alın, saatler güne göre değişiyor, gitmeden siteyi kontrol edin.

sparks.why: Seattle Christmas Market at Seattle Center, opening 20 Nov 2026 per VisitSeattle and Seattle Refined; timed tickets per Seeing Washington. The 17:00 start is a suggested evening time, not a published hour.
